title: Tailwind CSS
description: Utility-first Tailwind CSS reference covering setup, layout, responsive variants, state, theme variables, arbitrary values, component composition, accessibility, performance, and production practices.

subtopics.title: Installation & Source Detection
subtopics.description: Import Tailwind once, ensure source detection reaches templates, and keep generated class names statically discoverable.

codeBlocks.code: <button class="rounded-lg bg-sky-600 px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-sky-500">Save</button>

callouts.title: Do Not Construct Class Fragments
callouts.text: Map complete class strings from props or state. Dynamic fragments such as bg-${color}-500 may not be detected during generation.

subtopics.title: Spacing, Sizing, Color & Typography
subtopics.description: Compose utilities around consistent design tokens; use arbitrary values for exceptional one-offs, not as an ungoverned parallel design system.

subtopics.title: Flexbox, Grid & Positioning
subtopics.description: Use flex for one-dimensional distribution, grid for two-dimensional tracks, and positioning only when content should leave normal flow.

codeBlocks.code:
<main class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[16rem_minmax(0,1fr)]">
  <aside class="lg:sticky lg:top-4 lg:self-start">...</aside>
  <section class="min-w-0">...</section>
</main>

callouts.title: min-w-0 Fixes Many Overflow Bugs
callouts.text: Flex and grid children may refuse to shrink below intrinsic content size. Add min-w-0 to the shrinking child and handle overflow intentionally.

subtopics.title: Breakpoints & Container Queries
subtopics.description: Unprefixed utilities are the mobile baseline; min-width variants layer upward. Container queries respond to component space rather than viewport size.

callouts.title: Do Not Use sm: as Mobile
callouts.text: sm: applies at the small breakpoint and above. Put mobile styles unprefixed, then override progressively.

subtopics.title: State, Group, Peer, Data & Dark Variants
subtopics.description: Variants condition utilities on interaction, ancestry, siblings, attributes, media preferences, or color scheme.

subtopics.title: Component Composition & Class Merging
subtopics.description: Extract repeated UI as framework components; use class helpers for conditional complete utilities and define conflict policy when accepting className.

callouts.title: Avoid Premature @apply Abstraction
callouts.text: Framework components preserve variants, props, semantics, and behavior. Use CSS extraction for genuine shared CSS boundaries, not merely long class lists.

subtopics.title: Accessibility, Focus & Motion
subtopics.description: Utilities do not supply semantics. Use native elements, visible focus, sufficient contrast, reduced-motion variants, and logical reading order.

subtopics.title: Debugging & Production Checklist
subtopics.description: Inspect computed styles and active variants, verify source detection, test responsive/container states, and govern tokens centrally.

callouts.title: Production Checklist
callouts.text: Keep class strings discoverable, test dark/high-contrast/reduced-motion modes, avoid arbitrary-value sprawl, preserve semantic HTML, check overflow at zoom, and document token ownership.
